sentences.text: Learned APP waives service of notice of rule for and on behalf of respondent-State.
2. Heard Mr. Tushar Chaudhary, learned advocate for the applicant and Ms. Maithili Mehta, learned APP for the respondent-State.

3. This quashing application is filed by the applicant- accused namely Shravankumar Kesharamji Shravankumar Kesharamji Prajapati vs State Of Gujarat on 15 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/100399918/

sentences.text: . The applicant has been arraigned in the alleged offence registered with Naroda Police Station, District: Ahmedabad for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 366(k) and 376 of the IPC and Sections 3, 4, 5(j)(2) and 5(L) of the POCSO Act.
Admittedly, the criminal proceedings against the principal accused has been quashed by way of compromise.

As per the NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/9679/2022 ORDER DATED: 15/12/2023 undefined case of prosecution, the applicant-accused facilitated the principal accused and accordingly, he has been arraigned in the alleged offence.

4. Considering the role attributed to the present applicant and in view of quashing of criminal proceedings qua the principal accused, this Court is convinced that continuation of criminal proceedings qua the present applicant would amount to misuse of process of law and Court.
5. Resultantly, the present application is allowed.
Sessions Case No.346 of 2016 pending before Additional City and Sessions Court (Special POCSO Court), Ahmedabad, District:

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Ahmedabad is hereby quashed qua the present applicant.
